question: If A + B means A is the father of B; A - B means A is the wife of B; A × B means A is the brother of B; A ÷ B means A is the daughter of B. Which of the following expressions means 'P is the maternal uncle of Q'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Wife
 Brother
 Daughter
 
 

Given: P × S - R + Q

It means:

P is the **brother** of S,

S is the **wife** of R,

R is the **father** of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f3827864f56cfb8c743e1a2da604c375faa546294e294e0ae3b4eb7e1b9938.png] 

Therefore, P is the **maternal uncle** of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
